profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with a background in the military and a passion for producing results that make a positive impact for the team and for end users. I am always interested in learning and growing both personally as well as professionally.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Hospitality Global Business Unit (HGBU) - Oracle Hospitality Integration Platform
- Back-end development of a cloud-native (OCI), microservices application using Java, TypeScript, and Python.
- Managed and utilized CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes to deploy and maintain applications in multiple environments.
- Created and executed QA and API documentation for a database migration to Oracle ATP databases across multiple environments.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
APEX Central Engineering Team (ACE) - Oracle Hospitality Cruise Enterprise Configurator
- Built and updated applications using proprietary, cloud-native programming language called Oracle APEX.
- Developed using advanced SQL and PL/SQL statements to effectively retrieve and process data.
- Led Daily Scrum meetings to help the team stay on track, and navigate obstacles.
- Worked directly with the product manager, advising on new features, enhancements, and bug triage.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Consultant
positions.description:
- Full Stack development of secure web application and corresponding API using C#, ASP.NET MVC, and Entity Framework.
- Built new backend features to aid administrators in managing end user permissions and data access.
- Collaborative workflow with development team, QA team, and other key stakeholders, using Microsoft Visual Studio, SSMS (SQL Server Management Studio), Git, and Jira.
- Responsible for entire development life cycle, ensuring that updates and releases are integrated seamlessly to maintain optimal end user experience
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · JavaScript · Entity Framework · SQL Server Management Studio

positions.title: Technical Coach
positions.description:
- Meet with students engaged in Flatiron School curriculum to pair program and help them debug their own code, teaching them various skills, techniques, and best practices used in debugging. 
- Utilize the Socratic method to ensure that students have a proper understanding of key fundamental concepts, deepening their technical knowledge and acumen.
- Collaborate with over 30 teammates across the US to serve students worldwide, through 1-on-1 coding sessions and ensuring the quality of Flatiron School’s curriculum.
- Curriculum includes: JavaScript, React, Redux, Ruby, Rails, Sinatra, HTML, CSS, SQL
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching · JavaScript · React.js · Redux.js · Ruby on Rails · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- 15 Week Immersive Program – Full Stack Web Development
- Created 5 complete, deployable projects within the scope of the program
- Javascript, React, Ruby, Rails, HTML, CSS, SQLite, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Admissions Lead
positions.description:
- More than doubled revenue generated in the Washington DC market to become responsible for ~$1.2M quarterly.
- Managed competing priorities of local campus and HQ, building bridges with local teams and forging stronger and more effective relationships.
- Designed and implemented more streamlined admissions processes, cohort start management, and overall student experience.
- Launched new markets and programs, advising on strategic marketing and events to include: Seattle, Denver, Chicago, Data Science, UX/UI Design, and veteran initiatives such as GI-Bill implementation and VET-TEC.

positions.title: Inside Sales Representative
positions.description:
- Assumed responsibilities of Team Lead for Lead Development to include: delegating of daily incoming leads, reporting on Key Performance Indicators, and identifying inefficiencies for training purposes.
- Member of cross-departmental QA Testing Team for newer enhancements in Salesforce ensuring that the enhancements function properly and are optimized for day-to-day use. 
- Leveraged internal network of technical product engineers and other resources to help close potential sales.

positions.title: Military Police
positions.description:
- Awarded the Army Commendation Medal and the Army Achievement Medal on two occasions.
- Oversaw training of junior and senior soldiers on key skills and tasks.
- Maintained active Security Clearance throughout service.

positions.title: Staffing Executive
positions.description:
- Promoted to Staffing Executive in order to rebuild and manage Robert Half Technology’s Salaried Professional Service practice. 
- Managed entire breadth of careers for the active team of Salaried Professionals ensuring overall satisfaction of both clients and candidates.
- Proactively recruited (locate, screen, interview, vet, and condition) only the most marketable candidates (up to 100 resumes daily; 10-15 interviews weekly).

positions.title: Receiving Manager
positions.description:
- Created and assumed the role of Receiving Manager to address the need for proper and dedicated inventory management. 
- Managed the organization, accuracy and proper management of all warehouse inventory.

honors.title: The Army Achievement Medal
honors.description: For exceptionally meritorious service while assigned as a Team Leader with the 508th Military Police Company. Specialist Kim has distinguished himself in a position of increased responsibility. His dedication and devotion to duty are in keeping with the finest traditions of the United States Army and reflect great credit upon himself, the 508th Military Police Company, the 117th Combat Sustainment Support Battalion, the 42nd Regional Support Group, and the New Jersey Army National Guard.
honors.issuer: Issued by Colonel Timothy S. McLaughlin · Jun 2017

honors.title: The Army Commendation Medal
honors.description: For exceptionally meritorious service while serving with the 508th Military Police Company. Specialist Kim's weapons expertise and ability to train others served a vital role in the success of the training mission during Annual Training 2015. His dedication and devotion to duty is in keeping with the finest traditions of the United States Army and reflects great credit upon himself, the 508th Military Police Company, the 117th Combat Sustainment Support Battalion, the 42nd Regional Support Group, and the New Jersey Army National Guard.
honors.issuer: Issued by Colonel William L. Peace Sr. · Jul 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: I participated in Hurricane Katrina Relief in Waveland, Mississippi.  We helped clean up severely damaged properties.  The property owners often did not have the resources to clean their properties so I, along with my team, cleaned up for them.

Travelled to Tanzania to provide aid to local communities in the form of education and care for marginalized and disabled groups. I tracked all of the paperwork, passports, visas, and trainings for the team.
